scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build:site && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && (rsync -aL --ignore-errors apps/web/.open-next/ dist/ || [ $? -eq 23 ]) && mkdir -p dist/server dist/.openai && printf 'export { default } from "../worker.js";\n' > dist/server/index.js && cp .openai/hosting.json dist/.openai/hosting.json
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.docker logs -f api review-worker web postgres redis
